scenes.heading: Local SEO and Google Business Profile basics

sents.d: Local SEO and Google Business Profile basics
For a local or service business, showing up in local search often matters more than a polished website.

A complete, accurate Google Business Profile (hours, category, photos, service area) is often the single highest-leverage local marketing move — it's free, and it's frequently the first thing a potential customer sees before ever visiting a website.

Reviews weigh heavily on local ranking and trust: a simple habit of asking happy customers for a review right after a good experience, rather than hoping they think of it later, compounds significantly over months.

Keeping business information (address, phone, hours) identical across every listing — Google, Yelp, Facebook — avoids confusing both customers and search engines, which can penalize inconsistent listings.

take: A complete profile, steady reviews and consistent listings win locally.
